title: The Star Saloon, hard to place
summary: Nash remembers the Star Saloon but cannot place it, since so much has been torn down.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: Yes, I remember. Do you remember a place called the Star Saloon? I think it was called the Star? The Star?
Yes, I remember that too. Let me see, I'm trying to see where the Star is. I sure do.
It was on one of the side streets, Grabier, one of those streets I think.
It might have been on Claiborne even. It should have stopped.
It should have stopped. It should have stopped. It should have stopped.
What? The Star Saloon. I remember the Star Saloon all right, but I'm trying to figure out where it sat. I mean where it was. They tore down so much, you know.
They got to see the city looking so different.
